Full-lifecycle breadth: component libraries, REST APIs, CI/CD YAML pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes, AWS/Azure, technical SEO, and Core Web Vitals.

projects.name: Sovos Studio
projects.category: Enterprise SaaS · Interactive Data Visualization & Report Builder
projects.summary: Interactive enterprise report builder and data visualization studio backed by a Next.js API—enabling teams to create multi-page reports, USA choropleth and marker maps, charts, KPI cards, and data tables with a live spreadsheet editor and full admin governance.
projects.architecture: Full-stack React/Next.js API workspace featuring a drag-and-configure multi-page report canvas (Headings, Paragraphs, KPI cards, Charts, Data tables, Interactive choropleth/marker maps, Flowcharts/Timelines, Shapes, Graphics), a synchronized tabular dataset editor (CSV/XLSX upload, row/column editing, type conversion, sheet tabs), interactive hover tooltips, draft/publish lifecycle, version history, export controls, and an admin suite (User Management, Project Management, Audit Log, Integrations).
projects.challengesAndSolutions: Replaced fragmented third-party visualization workflows by uniting a live spreadsheet dataset editor directly with an interactive choropleth map and multi-page report canvas backed by Next.js API persistence, audit logging, and draft/publish state management.
highlights: Interactive USA Choropleth Map engine with color-coded regulatory grouping, custom legends, and dynamic hover tooltips per state.
Live spreadsheet dataset editor supporting CSV/XLSX upload, inline row/column editing, type conversions, and instant canvas updates.
Complete workspace & governance layer with Draft/Published lifecycle, Version History, Export, Admin Panel, User Management, Audit Log, and Integrations.

projects.name: StreamShield
projects.summary: Production-grade, privacy-first Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) built in strict TypeScript that automatically detects video ad interruptions across 9 streaming platforms and activates accessible Skip controls, optional DRM-safe VOD acceleration, or audio mute fallback with guaranteed post-ad restoration.
projects.architecture: Modular MV3 TypeScript architecture compiled with esbuild into dev/prod bundles: early document_start PlayerDiscovery & NavigationObserver, a centralized AdEngine driven by a 14-state deterministic FSM, PlayerManager for pre-ad snapshots and restoration, 9 independent StreamingPlatformAdapter modules (YouTube, JioHotstar/JioCinema, Amazon Prime Video, Netflix, Sony LIV, ZEE5, Hulu, Disney+ with Shadow-DOM piercing, and opt-in Generic), an isolated Shadow-DOM status pill, dark-mode popup dashboard & settings page, and an MV3 service worker with scoped host permissions and zero telemetry.
projects.challengesAndSolutions: Prevented false skips, broken DRM streams, and stuck audio states by enforcing verified skip accounting, excluding Skip Intro/Recap/Credits controls, keeping live sports & strict Widevine breaks at 1.0x with mute fallback, respecting manual unmutes, and verifying everything with Vitest unit/integration matrices and Playwright Chromium MV3 browser tests.
highlights: Supports 8 dedicated streaming platforms (YouTube, JioHotstar/JioCinema, Amazon Prime Video, Netflix, Sony LIV, ZEE5, Hulu, Disney+) plus an opt-in Generic adapter via per-origin optional permissions.
14-state deterministic FSM with verified skip accounting, DRM step-down & cooldown recovery, live-stream protection, and guaranteed restoration of pre-ad volume, mute state, and playback rate.
Collects zero browsing history, watch data, or analytics and makes zero external network requests; tested end-to-end with Vitest and Playwright against compiled MV3 Chromium builds.

projects.name: NovaCut Studio
projects.summary: Free, open-source AI clip maker that turns YouTube, Twitch, and Kick streams into captioned 9:16 vertical clips for Shorts, Reels, and TikTok using local transcription and an NLP engine.
projects.architecture: Combines a local transcription and NLP highlight-detection pipeline with optional pluggable LLM providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Ollama), per-creator isolated workspaces, real-time live clipping, scheduled auto-posting, and a dark-mode web studio dashboard featuring a video scrubber and interactive caption designer.
projects.challengesAndSolutions: Eliminated mandatory paid cloud-transcription dependencies by running local transcription and an NLP engine while keeping LLM selection modular (supporting local Ollama alongside Gemini, OpenAI, and Claude).
highlights: Turns YouTube, Twitch, and Kick streams into captioned 9:16 clips for Shorts, Reels, and TikTok.
Real-time live clipping, per-creator workspaces, and scheduled auto-posting.
Optional LLM integrations (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Ollama) + dark-mode dashboard with video scrubber and caption designer.
